meaning_vi: khuyến khích tài năng từ cơ sở

examples.en: Encouraging grassroots talent through school programmes ensures a steady supply of future champions.

title: encourage continuous improvement
meaning_vi: khuyến khích sự cải thiện liên tục

examples.en: Setting personal targets rather than focusing solely on winning can encourage continuous improvement among young athletes.

title: establish realistic objectives
meaning_vi: đặt ra mục tiêu thực tế

examples.en: Young athletes who establish realistic objectives are less likely to become discouraged by early defeats.

title: view failure as a valuable learning opportunity
term: view failure as a valuable learning opportunity
pronunciation: /vjuː ˈfeɪljə əz ə ˈvæljuəbl ˈlɜːnɪŋ ˌɒpəˈtjuːnəti/
meaning_vi: xem thất bại là cơ hội học hỏi quý giá

examples.en: Coaches encourage young players to view failure as a valuable learning opportunity rather than a cause for shame.

title: affiliations
meaning_vi: mối liên kết, quan hệ hợp tác

examples.en: The federation's affiliations with several airlines helped reduce travel costs for the national team.

title: By way of illustration
meaning_vi: để minh họa, ví dụ như

examples.en: By way of illustration, consider how sponsorship revenue transformed the finances of English football in the 1990s.

title: commercial sponsorship
meaning_vi: tài trợ thương mại

examples.en: Commercial sponsorship has transformed amateur competitions into highly profitable television events.

title: economic and political importance
meaning_vi: tầm quan trọng về kinh tế và chính trị

examples.en: Major sporting events are often given economic and political importance far beyond the game itself.

title: Internationally-acclaimed
meaning_vi: được quốc tế công nhận, ca ngợi

examples.en: The internationally-acclaimed tennis tournament attracts spectators and sponsors from every continent each year.

title: product endorsements
meaning_vi: việc người nổi tiếng quảng cáo sản phẩm

examples.en: Many athletes earn far more from product endorsements than they do from prize money.

title: sponsorships from large corporations
meaning_vi: các khoản tài trợ từ những tập đoàn lớn

examples.en: Without sponsorships from large corporations, many national teams would struggle to compete abroad.

title: the financial backing
meaning_vi: sự hậu thuẫn tài chính

examples.en: Without the financial backing of a major sponsor, the club would never have reached the top division.

title: the phenomenon of business-funded sports
meaning_vi: hiện tượng thể thao được doanh nghiệp tài trợ

examples.en: The phenomenon of business-funded sports has grown rapidly alongside the rise of global television audiences.

title: well-known brands
meaning_vi: các thương hiệu nổi tiếng

examples.en: Well-known brands often pay millions to sponsor jerseys during international tournaments.

title: overwhelming popularity
meaning_vi: sự nổi tiếng áp đảo, được yêu thích vượt trội

examples.en: Football enjoys overwhelming popularity across almost every continent.

title: secure the highest ratings
meaning_vi: đạt được tỷ suất người xem cao nhất

examples.en: Broadcasters compete fiercely to secure the highest ratings during major sporting finals.

title: television coverage
meaning_vi: sự đưa tin, phát sóng trên truyền hình

examples.en: Increased television coverage of women's basketball has helped grow its fan base significantly.

title: viewership
meaning_vi: lượng người xem

examples.en: Women's football has seen a sharp rise in viewership over the past decade.

title: astronomical amount of money
meaning_vi: số tiền khổng lồ

examples.en: Top football clubs now pay an astronomical amount of money to sign a single star player.

title: become a fertile ground for advertisements
term: become a fertile ground for advertisements
meaning_vi: trở thành mảnh đất màu mỡ cho quảng cáo

examples.en: Major football leagues have become a fertile ground for advertisements, with brand logos covering every surface of the pitch.

title: bring about negative consequences
meaning_vi: gây ra những hậu quả tiêu cực

examples.en: Endorsing an unhealthy product can bring about negative consequences for an athlete's public image.

title: enhancing the sports-viewing experience for supporters
term: enhancing the sports-viewing experience for supporters
pronunciation: /ɪnˈhɑːn.sɪŋ ðə spɔːts ˈvjuː.ɪŋ ɪkˈspɪər.i.əns fɔː səˈpɔː.təz/
meaning_vi: nâng cao trải nghiệm xem thể thao cho người hâm mộ

examples.en: Investment in giant screens has gone a long way toward enhancing the sports-viewing experience for supporters.

title: featured junk food
meaning_vi: quảng cáo/giới thiệu đồ ăn vặt

examples.en: The campaign was criticised because it featured junk food alongside images of professional athletes.

title: notable downsides
meaning_vi: những mặt trái đáng chú ý

examples.en: Despite its popularity, corporate sponsorship carries some notable downsides for the integrity of a sport.

title: reap a myriad of financial benefits
term: reap a myriad of financial benefits
meaning_vi: thu về vô số lợi ích tài chính

examples.en: Host cities can reap a myriad of financial benefits, from hotel bookings to long-term tourism growth.

title: the monetary merits
meaning_vi: những lợi ích về mặt tiền bạc

examples.en: Beyond the monetary merits, hosting a tournament can also boost national morale for years afterwards.

title: viewership in the billions
meaning_vi: lượng người xem lên tới hàng tỷ

examples.en: The men's football World Cup regularly attracts viewership in the billions worldwide.

title: diminish the spirit of sportsmanship
meaning_vi: làm suy giảm tinh thần thể thao

examples.en: Excessive commercial pressure can diminish the spirit of sportsmanship that competitions are meant to embody.

title: potential pitfalls
meaning_vi: những cạm bẫy, rủi ro tiềm ẩn

examples.en: Before signing any sponsorship deal, athletes should carefully weigh the potential pitfalls involved.

title: wield an inappropriate degree of influence
term: wield an inappropriate degree of influence
meaning_vi: sử dụng mức độ ảnh hưởng không phù hợp

examples.en: Some critics fear that sponsors wield an inappropriate degree of influence over team selection decisions.

title: good deeds
meaning_vi: những việc làm tốt, nghĩa cử

examples.en: The football club is known for its good deeds, such as funding scholarships for disadvantaged children.

title: offer satisfactory remuneration
meaning_vi: trả mức thù lao thỏa đáng

examples.en: Clubs must offer satisfactory remuneration if they want to retain their most talented young players.

title: the enhancement of broadcasting technology
meaning_vi: sự cải tiến của công nghệ truyền hình, phát sóng

examples.en: The enhancement of broadcasting technology has allowed fans worldwide to watch matches in stunning detail.

title: to fulfill their corporate social responsibility
term: to fulfill their corporate social responsibility
meaning_vi: để thực hiện trách nhiệm xã hội của doanh nghiệp

examples.en: Many companies sponsor youth sports programmes to fulfill their corporate social responsibility.

title: existing societal inequalities
meaning_vi: những bất bình đẳng xã hội hiện có

examples.en: Sport should aim to reduce, not reinforce, existing societal inequalities between rich and poor communities.

title: lower socio-economic backgrounds
meaning_vi: xuất thân từ tầng lớp kinh tế - xã hội thấp

examples.en: Children from lower socio-economic backgrounds often lack access to proper coaching and equipment.

title: a privileged few
meaning_vi: một số ít người có đặc quyền

examples.en: Access to elite coaching should not be limited to a privileged few who can afford private academies.

title: a stunning testament
meaning_vi: một minh chứng đáng kinh ngạc

examples.en: Her record-breaking run is a stunning testament to years of relentless training.

title: an uneven playing field
meaning_vi: một sân chơi không công bằng

examples.en: Unequal funding between schools creates an uneven playing field for aspiring young athletes.

title: come at the cost
meaning_vi: phải trả giá bằng, đánh đổi bằng

examples.en: Funding elite academies can come at the cost of neglecting sports programmes for the wider public.

title: devote more air time to men's sporting events
term: devote more air time to men's sporting events
pronunciation: /dɪˈvəʊt mɔːr eə taɪm tə menz ˈspɔːtɪŋ ɪˈvents/
meaning_vi: dành nhiều thời lượng phát sóng hơn cho các sự kiện thể thao nam

examples.en: Many broadcasters still devote more air time to men's sporting events than to women's.

title: perpetuates
meaning_vi: duy trì, kéo dài (điều gì đó, thường tiêu cực)

examples.en: Charging high membership fees only perpetuates the exclusion of poorer families from competitive sport.

title: showcase men's sports over women's
meaning_vi: ưu tiên giới thiệu thể thao nam hơn thể thao nữ

examples.en: Critics argue that networks continue to showcase men's sports over women's due to advertising revenue.

title: skewed towards
meaning_vi: thiên lệch, nghiêng về phía

examples.en: Investment in sports facilities is often skewed towards wealthier neighbourhoods rather than deprived areas.

title: thrust women's sports into the limelight
term: thrust women's sports into the limelight
meaning_vi: đưa thể thao nữ vào tầm chú ý của công chúng

examples.en: The Women's World Cup has thrust women's sports into the limelight like never before.

title: different social classes
meaning_vi: các tầng lớp xã hội khác nhau

examples.en: Free community sports centres allow people from different social classes to play together.

title: alter public perception over time
meaning_vi: dần dần thay đổi nhận thức của công chúng theo thời gian

examples.en: Greater media coverage of female athletes could gradually alter public perception over time.

title: community-based programs
meaning_vi: các chương trình dựa vào cộng đồng

examples.en: Local governments should fund community-based programs that give every child a chance to play sport.

title: foster a more inclusive and equitable society
term: foster a more inclusive and equitable society
pronunciation: /ˈfɒs.tər ə mɔːr ɪnˈkluː.sɪv ənd ˈek.wɪ.tə.bəl səˈsaɪ.ə.ti/
meaning_vi: thúc đẩy một xã hội hòa nhập và công bằng hơn

examples.en: Investing in public sports facilities can help foster a more inclusive and equitable society for future generations.

title: make the world of sports coverage less divided
term: make the world of sports coverage less divided
pronunciation: /meɪk ðə wɜːld əv spɔːts ˈkʌvərɪdʒ les dɪˈvaɪdɪd/
meaning_vi: làm cho việc đưa tin thể thao công bằng/ít phân biệt hơn

examples.en: Broadcasting more female tournaments would make the world of sports coverage less divided.
